exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.description: Compound lower-body strength movement targeting quads and glutes.
instructions: Set up bar across upper back and unrack with feet shoulder-width.
Descend by bending hips and knees to at least parallel while keeping chest up.
Drive through mid-foot to return to standing; brace core throughout.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.description: Full-body hinge focusing on posterior chain strength and hip drive.
instructions: Stand with feet under the bar, hinge at hips and grip bar outside knees.
Drive hips forward while keeping a neutral spine and locked lats until standing.
Lower the bar with control by hinging at the hips back to the floor.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Foundational pressing movement to build chest strength.
instructions: Lie on bench with eyes under the bar, retract shoulder blades and plant feet.
Unrack the bar, lower to mid-chest with control, then press to full extension.
Keep wrists neutral and drive feet/hips for stability on heavy sets.

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.description: Horizontal pull building mid-back thickness and strength.
instructions: Hinge at the hips to a flat back and grip the bar slightly wider than knees.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs while squeezing shoulder blades together.
Control the descent and avoid excessive torso movement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.description: Dumbbell standing press to build shoulder stability and size.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at shoulder height and a braced core.
Press overhead until arms are extended without shrugging excessively.
Lower with control to the start position.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.description: Vertical pulling movement for lat and upper-back development.
instructions: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and hang fully.
Pull chest toward the bar by driving elbows down and back until chin clears.
Lower with control to full hang.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Press
exercises.description: Upper-chest focused press performed on an incline bench.
instructions: Lie back on an incline bench with dumbbells at chest level.
Press the weights up and slightly together, then lower under control.
Focus on upper-chest contraction and avoid flaring elbows excessively.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.description: Unilateral leg work for balance, core stability, and quad development.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and step forward into a deep lunge.
Push through the front heel to step forward and repeat, keeping torso upright.
Alternate legs and maintain steady tempo for balance.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
exercises.description: Isolation movement for chest shape and contraction using cables.
instructions: Set pulleys to chest height and hold handles with a slight forward lean.
Bring hands together in front of chest with a soft bend in elbows and squeeze.
Return under control to the start keeping tension on the chest.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: Controlled horizontal pull for lats and mid-back engagement.
instructions: Sit tall with knees slightly bent and a neutral spine, grip the handle.
Drive elbows back and squeeze shoulder blades together as you row.
Control the return and avoid leaning excessively.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.description: Upper-body pressing variation emphasizing lower chest and triceps.
instructions: Grip parallel bars and lower body by bending elbows to about 90 degrees.
Press back up to full elbow extension focusing on chest/triceps drive.
Keep shoulders down and avoid excessive forward lean if shoulder pain occurs.

exercises.name: Barbell Split Squat
exercises.description: Single-leg barbell split squat for strength and balance.
instructions: Set one foot forward and one back with bar on your back, keep torso upright.
Lower until front thigh is near parallel, then drive through the front heel.
Keep weight evenly balanced and control the descent.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.description: Isolation triceps movement using a cable pulley for constant tension.
instructions: Stand upright and grip the bar with elbows pinned to your sides.
Extend the elbows fully while keeping upper arms still, then return slowly.
Focus on squeezing the triceps at the bottom of each rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
exercises.description: Classic arm isolation for biceps peak and strength.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at your sides and curl with elbows stationary.
Squeeze at the top and lower under control to full extension.
Avoid swinging; use controlled tempo for muscle tension.

exercises.name: Flat Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Bench-based dumbbell press to build balanced chest strength with a greater range of motion.
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench holding dumbbells at chest level.
Press the weights up until arms are extended, then lower slowly.
Keep shoulder blades packed and maintain even range of motion.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.description: Machine leg press to load the quads with controlled foot position and reduced back strain.
instructions: Sit on the machine with feet shoulder-width on the plate and controlled range.
Lower the sled until knees are about 90 degrees, then press back to start.
Avoid locking knees at full extension.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.description: Explosive hip hinge movement for posterior chain power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than hip-width and hinge at hips to swing the bell.
Explosively extend hips to swing to chest height while bracing the core.
Control the downswing and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Seated Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Machine-based shoulder press offering stability and consistent range of motion.
instructions: Adjust seat so handles align with mid-shoulder and keep back against pad.
Press handles up until arms are extended, then lower under control.
Use a full range without locking out aggressively.

templates.name: Push / Pull / Legs
templates.description: Three-way split separating pushing, pulling, and lower-body sessions for focused training.
templates.help: Use heavier compound lifts early in the session; finish with isolation for volume.

templates.name: Upper / Lower
templates.description: Alternating upper- and lower-body sessions for balanced frequency and recovery.
templates.help: Aim for 2 upper and 2 lower sessions per week; prioritize compound lifts first.

templates.name: Bro Split
templates.description: Single-muscle-focus days (Chest, Back, Legs, Shoulders, Arms) for high-volume specialization.
templates.help: Use higher rep ranges and varied angles to target each muscle thoroughly.

templates.name: Full Body
templates.description: Whole-body sessions focusing on major compound lifts for overall strength and conditioning.
templates.help: Keep session volume manageable (3-5 main sets per lift) and prioritize recovery.
